derivatives.name: hy_ig_spread_pct
derivatives.definition: HY OAS minus IG OAS in percentage points.
derivatives.formula: raw column — BAMLH0A0HYM2EY minus BAMLC0A0CMEY (FRED series, monthly)

derivatives.name: hy_ig_zscore_12m
derivatives.definition: 12-month rolling z-score of the HY-IG spread.

derivatives.name: hy_ig_zscore_24m
derivatives.definition: 24-month rolling z-score of the HY-IG spread.

derivatives.name: hy_ig_zscore_36m
derivatives.definition: 36-month rolling z-score of the HY-IG spread.

derivatives.name: hy_ig_pctrank_12m
derivatives.definition: 12-month percentile rank of the HY-IG spread.

derivatives.name: hy_ig_pctrank_24m
derivatives.definition: 24-month percentile rank of the HY-IG spread.

derivatives.name: hy_ig_pctrank_36m
derivatives.definition: 36-month percentile rank of the HY-IG spread.

derivatives.name: hy_ig_roc_1m
derivatives.definition: 1-month percent rate of change of the HY-IG spread.

derivatives.name: hy_ig_roc_3m
derivatives.definition: 3-month percent rate of change of the HY-IG spread.

derivatives.name: hy_ig_roc_6m
derivatives.definition: 6-month percent rate of change of the HY-IG spread.

derivatives.name: hy_ig_mom_1m
derivatives.definition: 1-month absolute change of the HY-IG spread in percentage points.

derivatives.name: hy_ig_mom_3m
derivatives.definition: 3-month absolute change of the HY-IG spread in percentage points.

derivatives.name: hy_ig_acceleration
derivatives.definition: Change in the 1-month rate-of-change of the HY-IG spread.

derivatives.name: hmm_2state_prob_stress
derivatives.definition: HMM 2-state stress regime probability; posterior probability that the current month is in the high-spread stress state.
derivatives.formula: HMM 2-state model fitted on hy_ig_spread_pct; P(state=stress | observations_1:t)

derivatives.name: spy_log_return
derivatives.definition: SPY monthly log return computed from end-of-month close prices.

notes: Full-history dataset 1996-12-31 to 2026-05-29 (354 months). Prior v4 run constrained to 35 obs — resolved.
